{{Infobox auto}}

'''Lumpia''' are fried spring rolls that grant two effects: {{EffectLink|Water Breathing}} and {{EffectLink|Night Vision}}, both for 5 minutes. They heal {{Hp|6}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/lumpia.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[Cooked Porkchop|cooked porkchop]] or [[seitan]], dough, [[oil]], [[Dried Kelp|dried kelp]] and a carrot make 2. Obtaining oil unlocks the recipe. The oil's glass bottle is meant to be given back, but in 1.12.2-beta the advancement that returns it still names the recipe by an old ID, so it is used up.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating lumpia takes 1.2 seconds, heals {{Hp|6}} and gives Water Breathing and Night Vision for 5:00 each.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].
